Ticked P5 in plan.md and elements 15-19, 21, 27 (plus 16, the lawn the build lays down) in elements.md.
Stair facing follows vocab.mjs (facing = tall side, rising toward facing); plan.md's note says the opposite and the portico steps follow vocab.
left: Plan conflict: the young oak at x8 z2 sits inside the driveway (x1..16 z0..4), so the trunk stands on the concrete and the canopy overhangs it. Built at the spec coordinate. Planner to move the tree (e.g. x19 z2) or trim the driveway.

Not mine, seen in check: 4 floating spruce_slab at x47 z21..24 y10 and 5 orphan spruce_slab at the wall ends (x0/x47, y10). Likely roof or shell; the build is 48 wide because the roof preset shifted x by +2.
